facts.text: I have a spot on my lower lip.
I don't have any other complaints or symptoms.
I smoke a pack of cigarettes a day, and have for the last 20 years.
I work as a fruit picker. I've done that for the past 25 years.

findings.name: lip and mouth examination
findings.result: Single ulcer near the vermilion border of the lower lip, without any obvious signs of healing; non-tender on palpation.

findings.name: biopsy of the lip lesion
findings.result: Dysplasia and keratin pearls, consistent with squamous cell carcinoma.

aliases: squamous cell carcinoma of the lip
squamous cell carcinoma of the lower lip

quotes.f003: Painless lesion on the lower lip
quotes.f004: No other complaints or symptoms reported.
quotes.f009: one pack per day habit for the last 20 years
quotes.f010: worked as a fruit picker for the past 25 years

x005.source_text: Single ulcer near the vermillion border of the lower lip, without any obvious signs of healing. The ulcer is non-tender on palpation.

x006.source_text: Dysplasia and keratin pearls, consistent with squamous cell carcinoma

leakage.reason: The biopsy result names the diagnosis ('consistent with squamous cell carcinoma'); kept because that is the test's answer, and it is only seen when the doctor orders the biopsy.

source_issues: The gold diagnosis is visible in the biopsy result (pool flag visible_gold_alias_partitions: test_results).
'vermillion' is misspelled in the oral examination (vermilion).
notes: The source says 'lesion'; the patient calls it a 'spot' (lay word, no claim about pain or ulceration); 'lip lesion', 'sore' and 'ulcer' are aliases.

Smoking (p001, p003) and occupation (p001, p003) each merge into one fact. 'Works outside' becomes a separate exposure fact (f011) because it answers a sun-exposure question; the source does not mention sun or sunscreen, so the text states only that the work is outdoors.
'No other complaints or symptoms reported' (p004) is a denial of other symptoms (f004).
The oral examination leaf is one record; the system is 'skin' to match the lip-lesion fact.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with a lesion on his lower lip, taking into consideration his medical history and habits.
